description: Visualize your organization's structure and monitor performance in a single, dynamic org chart. Perfect for mapping teams, hierarchies, processes, and supply chains — with built-in KPI tracking. Unlock the full power of organizational clarity. The Org Chart visual combines the simplicity of a classic hierarchy diagram with the analytical depth of a KPI dashboard. Whether you're mapping your company structure, a production line, or a project team, it gives you an intuitive, interactive view of how your organization is structured — and how it's performing. Who is this for? HR & Operations Managers: Visualize team structures and track departmental efficiency across complex organizational hierarchies. Executive Leadership: Get a bird's-eye view of your organization to make rapid, informed strategic decisions. Financial Analysts: Map cost centers and departments while breaking down budgets vs. actuals at every level. Operations & Manufacturing Managers: Chart production lines, identify bottlenecks, and monitor KPIs across process stages. Supply Chain Leads: Visualize vendor relationships and logistics flows in a clear hierarchical view. Project Managers: Map workstreams and track task completion status across complex project structures. Instantly identify which branch of your organization is underperforming (Red/Negative) or exceeding targets (Green/Positive) — without digging…
